lang_code.description: Language code to match (e.g., 'pa' for Punjabi/Gurmukhi)

family.description: The generic font family to target for substitution

font_name.description: The specific font name to prepend to the font stack

fonthashint.description: Whether to append hinting information to the font hash

alias_family.description: The fallback family when Noto Sans Gurmukhi is unavailable or aliased
